notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
easyPrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Sanctum Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
